The Ferry at Grey Reach (invented for DMbot's tests; every name here is made up)

Grey Reach is a ferry landing on the wide Harrow river. Pell Arrow, an old halfling, runs the ferry and keeps the toll hut. Sergeant Duna Kell guards the landing for the river lords.

Four travellers wait for the ferry: Cerric Vanya'elen, Belleros Stormgrace, Okthandom Korran and Claude Ambere.
